turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for confirming your identity. Your past-due amount is $412.50. How would you like to handle it?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I can pay $150 on November 10.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I've noted a payment of $150.00 on November 10.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your account is 22 days past due with $380.00 owed. Can we set up a payment?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Money's tight but I get paid next Friday. I'll send two hundred bucks then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood, two hundred dollars next Friday. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're verified. The past-due amount on your account is $250.00.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I can't pay anything right now, I lost my job last month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like to hear about hardship options?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Maybe later. Not today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How much could you pay toward the $700.00 past due?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I can do $300 on the 15th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, $300 on November 15.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Wait, actually make it $250. I forgot my car insurance is due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem, $250 on November 15 then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there an amount you could commit to this week?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay a hundred and fifty dollars tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, I've recorded that.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I already paid $75 last Friday. Check your records.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don't see it yet. Payments can take up to 3 business days to post.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: OK, I'll wait and call back.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your balance is $1,200.00. Would you like to discuss a plan?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: No plan needed. I'll pay the full $1,200 this Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, the full amount this Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could you make a payment toward the $900.00 past due?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: If my tax refund comes in, I could pay 500 next week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Please reach out once you know more.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could you pay $95 by Friday, November 13?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Yes, that works for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I've noted $95.00 on November 13.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your past-due amount is $180.00.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay $60 at the end of the month. That's all I can manage.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood, $60 at the end of the month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When could you make a payment?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay $100 sometime next week, not sure which day yet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Let us know the day when you can.
